title: Political Bias in LLMs: Unaligned Moral Values in Agent-centric Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ) when prompted with different political personas (Liberal, Moderate, Conservative) and calculating the distance to human ideological baseline data.
Cross-evaluating model-generated MFQ responses against human baseline data from both Western (US) and non-Western (South Korean) populations to identify implicit Western biases.
